codes.meaning: Every check required by the selected profile passed.
A frozen size, count, depth, or processing limit was exceeded.
A top-level input required by the selected profile was absent.
A required JSON object could not be parsed under the frozen strict parser.
A JSON object contained a duplicate property name.
Manifest bytes were not the RFC 8785 representation of their parsed data.
A parsed object failed its frozen schema.
A path was absolute, escaped the release root, or was not portable under the frozen path policy.
Two entries resolved to the same normalized path.
A listed payload was or traversed a symbolic link.
A listed payload had more than one filesystem link under the frozen single-link policy.
A listed payload was not a regular file.
A required input changed while it was being verified.
The manifest omitted a role required by the release profile.
A manifest-listed payload was absent.
A payload-root file was absent from the closed-world manifest.
A payload byte size differed from the manifest value.
A recomputed full SHA-256 differed from the manifest value.
The selected profile required an attestation but none was present.
The envelope, certificate, Statement, or bundle failed structural validation.
The signature or digest algorithm was not allowed by the frozen policy.
Signature cryptography failed for the authenticated envelope/message.
The signing certificate was not valid at the authenticated signing time under the frozen policy.
Required public transparency/timestamp evidence was missing or invalid.
The cryptographic signer identity was not authorized by the frozen policy.
Repository, workflow, ref, or builder identity did not match the frozen policy.
The authenticated subject digest did not equal the exact manifest-byte SHA-256.
The authenticated in-toto predicateType was not the frozen SLSA provenance type.
Authenticated source repository or full revision differed from policy.
An official release build was not produced from the frozen clean-source condition.
A required authenticated material digest differed from policy.
The verifier failed to produce a policy decision.
